result.rationale: In refreshOAuthTokens, the fetch to process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT includes only method and body (URLSearchParams with calcomUserId/appSlug) — no Authorization header, and the raw response object is returned without checking response.ok, so a non-2xx/error body would flow into token parsing downstream (e.g., handleZoomResponse/parseRefreshTokenResponse receive it). This is verifiable in the diff.
